firecrawl_scrape._note: `formats` is a real discriminator invisible to the list advisory (array-typed): the response gains one key per requested format. Probed formats=<default> and formats=[markdown,html,links,summary]; the union is a total=False base model. `links` (list[str]) and `metadata` (nested dict) are left out of `fields` per the top-level-scalars rule; screenshot/json/branding/audio formats were not probed.

firecrawl_search._note: Confirmed discriminator: `sources` / `categories` (both array-typed, so invisible to the list advisory — found by the description sweep). Four variants probed: default -> data.web, categories=[developer] -> data.web with an extra `category` key (the description claims `data.developer`; the server does not do that), sources=[news] -> data.news, sources=[images] -> data.images. Resolved as a generic base model (option 2) over the unwrapped `data` envelope; each bucket is present-or-absent, its item model varies by variant, so items stay untyped.
